subject.title: ScreenCaptureKit transient-denial retry swallows cancellation (second attempt after cancel)

question: Does the live production-runner transcript in https://github.com/openclaw/Peekaboo/pull/290 satisfy the previously stated ScreenCaptureKit proof gate, or must the contributor additionally demonstrate signed true-TCC denial and the permission-probe path?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but the earlier maintainer closeout imposed a specific proof threshold that the new evidence intentionally does not fully meet; accepting or waiving that threshold is maintainer judgment.

options.title: Require the remaining live proof
options.body: Keep the current gate and request a properly signed true-TCC-denial run plus permission-probe coverage before landing the combined fix.

options.title: Waive the remaining gate
options.body: Accept the real `SCStreamErrorDomain` runner proof and focused regressions as sufficient for this bounded cancellation fix.
